tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa bzhugs so//

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ārya tā rā bha dra nā ma aṣṭa sha ta ka /bod skad du/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan yid 'ong po ṭa lar// sna tshogs khams kyis rnam par spras// sna tshogs ljon pas bkram pa ste// skye gnyis du ma sgra 'byin pa// 'babs chu sna tshogs ku co che// ri dwags sna tshogs 'khrugs pa ste// me tog sna tshogs rigs rnams kyis// kun tu dri yis bkang ba ste// sna tshogs yid 'ong 'bras bur ldan// rkang pa drug pa glu yi sgra// mi 'am ci yis glu snyan len// glang chen smyon pas yang dag khengs// rig 'dzin grub pa'i tshogs rnams dang*// dri za rnams kyang glu len pa// thub pa 'dod chags bral rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs gzhan dang*// sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams dang ni// 'phags ma sgrol sogs lha mo rnams// rigs pa'i rgyal mo stong rnams kyis// rtag tu legs par bsten pa'o// khro bo'i rgyal po tshogs gzhan dang*// rta mgrin la sogs kyis bskor ba// sems can kun la phan par brtson// bcom ldan 'das ni spyan ras gzigs// bzhugs te de phyir dpal dang ldan// padma'i snying pa thub pa'i gdan// dka' thub chen po dang ldan pa// byams pa dang ni snying rje ldan// lha yi 'khor ni chen po la// chos gsung po ni yang dag bzhugs// de ru nyer 'dug yang dag langs/ phyag na rdo rje stobs po che// mchog tu snying rje dang ldan pas// spyan ras gzigs la zhus pa ste// kun po sbrul dang seng ge dang*// glang po stag dang chu'i 'jigs pas// zhi mdzad thub pas sems can rnams// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying ba rnams// 'khor ba'i zhags pas bcings pa rnams// chags sdang gti mug dri ma las// gang gis sems can grol 'gyur ba// de gsungs bdag la thub chen po// de skad zhus nas bcom ldan 'das// 'jig rten mgon pos 'di skad gsungs// dpal ldan de ni spyan ras gzigs// phyag na rdo rje rab rtogs byed// snyan pa'i tshig ni 'di skad gsungs// nyon cig gsang ba'i rgyal dbang po// skyob pa 'od dpag med pa yis// smon lam stobs kyis byung ba ste// nga yis 'jig rten ma rung shes// snying rje che dang ldan pa yis// 'gro ba 'dren par brtson pa mo// nyi ma shar ba dang 'dra ba// zla ba nya 'dra byad kyi 'od// lhar bcas mi dang lha min dang*// mi rnams thams cad gsal bar byed// 'jig rten gsum po g.yo bar byed// gnod sbyin srin po 'jigs par byed// phyag na utpal sngon po ste// ma 'jigs ma 'jigs zhes brjod ma// bar snang du ni 'bar bar gnas// 'gro ba yang dag gzung don du/

mtshon gyi bskal pa byung ba dang*// 'jigs pa sna tshogs 'khrugs don du/ rgyal ba rnams kyis bdag bskyed de// ming rnams dran pa nyid kyis ni// sems can thams cad bdag gis bsrungs// sna tshogs 'jigs pa'i rgya mtsho las// sems can thams cad bdag gis bsgral// des na bdag la 'jig rten du// rgyal ba'i tshogs kyis sgrol mar bsgrags// thal mo sbyar ba byas nas ni// spyan sngar 'dug ste 'di skad gsol// gsung cig mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa// sa bcu'i dbang phyug mgon rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rab dga' ba'i// sdig pa spong byed bsod nams dang*// bkra shis grags pa 'phel bar byed// gter dang nor rnams 'phel byed nyid/ nad rnams thams cad brlag par byed// dpal dang shes pa 'jog par byed// nad med tshe ni 'phel bar bar byed// sems can rnams la byams bsgoms la// de dag sgrogs shig thub chen po// spyan ras gzigs dbang rab tu bzhad// mchog rnams rab tu rnam gzigs nas// 'di lta bu yi byams pa spro/ phyag ni g.yas pas phyag thabs mdzad// bsod nams mtshan nyid ldan pa yis// de gsungs shes rab shin tu che// legs so legs so dka' thub che// sems can kun la gcig tu brtse// skal ba chen po'i mi rnams nyon// mi rnams gang zhig 'di sgrog pa/ nor gyi dbang phyug yang dag 'gyur/ nad rnams thams cad yang dag grol// dbang phyug kun dang yang dag ldan// dus min 'chi ba nges par bsregs// 'chi ba bde ba can 'gro ba// de rnams bdag gis bshad par bya// lha yi dge 'dun bdag la nyon// 'di la rjes su yi rang gis// legs par bsdams par 'gyur la bstod// oṃ dge ba can ni gzi brjid che// 'jig rten gso byed snyan pa che// dbyangs can ma ni spyan yangs ma// shes rab dpal dang blo 'phel ma// gso byed ma dang rgyas 'debs ma// swā hā/ oṃ gyis rnam pa'i 'dod gzugs ma// sems can kun la phan par brtson// g.yul las sgrol byed rgyal ba mo// lha mo shes rab pha rol phyin// 'phags ma sgrol ma yid 'ong ma// rdza rnga dud can rgyas pa mo// rig pa'i rgyal mo tshig snyan ma// zla ba'i gdong can dkar mo che// mi pham gos ni ser mo can// sgyu ma chen po dkar mo che// stobs po che la pha rol phyin// rtsub mo chen mo gtum chen mo// sdang ba'i sems can brlag byed ma// rab tu zhi ba zhi ba'i gzugs// rnam par rgyal ba 'bar ba'i 'od// glog gi phreng ba'i rgyal mtshan can// ral gri 'khor lo gzhu thogs mtshon// 'tshol byed rengs byed nag mo ni// mtshan mo nag mo mtshan spyod ma// srung byed rmongs byed zhi ba mo// mdzes ma dge ma 'dra ba'i lding*// tshangs pa mo dang rig byed mo// gsang ba mo ni brag phug gnas// bkra shis don byed zhi ba mo// skyes nas rig byed yid mgyogs ma// thod pa can ni shugs chen mo// tshangs ma bden ma gzhan mi rgyal// ded dpon chen mo snying rje gnas// chud zos pa la lam rab ston// mchog ster ster byed ston pa mo// bud med gzugs la dpag med gnon// ri khrod ma dang rnal 'byor ma// grub ma gtum ma bdud rtsi ma// nges ma nor ma bsod nams ma// skal chen skal bzang mdzes ston ma// mthar byed 'jig byed 'jigs byed ma// drag dang brtul zhugs chen mo ma// 'gro la gcig tu phan par brtson// skyabs byed gus byed gsong po ma// ngag gi dbang phyug zhi phra ma// rtag ma kun 'gro rjes 'gro ma// don kun sgrub byed bzang mo ma// gsang byed gso byed nor ster ma// mi 'jigs bsod nams gau ta ma// spyan ras gzigs dbang bdag nyid kyis// mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad 'di dag ni// phan par byed par grags pa ste// mchog tu rmad byung gsang ba po// lha yul na yang rnyed dka' ba// skal bzang skal ba dang ldan byed// dug rnams thams cad nyams byed pa// nad ni thams cad zhi byed ma// sems can kun la bde ster ma// blo ldan gang zhig lan gsum klog

/mnyam gzhag gtsang sbra byas pa yis// des ni dus mi ring ba ru// rgyal srid dpal yang thob par 'gyur// rtag tu sdug pa'ang bde bar 'gyur// bkren pa phyug por 'gyur ba'o// rmongs pa shes rab chen por 'gyur// yid gzhungs 'gyur ba the tshom med// bcings pa bcings las grol bar 'gyur// tha snyad las kyang rgyal bar 'gyur// dgra bo bshes por 'gyur ba ste// rwa can dang ni mche ba can// dog pa'i 'thab mo rgyal dka' dang*// sna tshogs 'jigs pa 'khrugs pa las// mtshan ni 'di rnams dran pa yis// 'jigs pa kun las sgrol bar byed// dus min 'chi las sgrol bar byed// skyes bu snyan pa thob par byed// mi ni skye ba don dang bcas// de gcig pu yi phan yon gyis// gang zhig 'di ni sngar langs nas// skyes bu gang zhig sgrogs byed pa// de ni dus ring tshe dang ldan// mi ni dpal gyis dga' 'gyur ste// lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang*// dri za dang ni lus srul po// 'byung po gshed byed srin po dang*// ma mo rtsub pa'i sems ldan pa// gnod sbyin mo dang yi dwags byed/ smyo byed dang ni gdon chen rnams// grib gnon dang ni brjed byed dang*// sha za la sogs pa rnams dang*// ro langs la sogs sna tshogs rnams// bskul byed gzhan sems sdang ba rnams// grib ma yang ni 'gom mi 'gyur// ji ltar slar ni mchod par 'gyur// sdang ba'i sems can 'ching bar 'gyur/ nad la sogs pas thebs mi 'gyur// phyug dang longs spyod yon tan ldan// bu dang tsha bo 'phel bar 'gyur/ blo ldan skye ba dran par 'gyur// rigs dang ldan zhing mthong dgar 'gyur// gzi brjid ldan zhing tshig gsal ba// bstan bcos thams cad rig par 'gyur// dge bshes bsnyen bkur yang dag bsten/ byang chub sems kyis brgyan pa dang*// gang dag gang du skyes pa der// rtag tu sangs rgyas kyis mi spong*// dpal ldan 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gsungs pa/

rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa rdzogs so/// / ༈ phyag 'tshal sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo// spyan ni skad cig glog dang 'dra ma// 'jig rten gsum mgon chu skyes zhal gyi// ge sar bye ba las ni byung ma/ phyag 'tshal ston ka'i zla ba kun tu// gang ba brgya ni brtsegs pa'i zhal ma// skar ma stong phrag tshogs pa rnams kyis// rab tu phye ba'i 'od rab 'bar ma// phyag 'tshal gser sngo chu las skyes kyi// padmas phyag ni rnam par brgyan ma// sbyin pa brtson 'grub dka' thub zhi ba// bzod pa bsam gtan spyod yul nyid ma// phyag 'tshal de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor// mtha' yas rnam par rgyal bar spyod ma// ma lus pha rol phyin pa thob pa'i// rgyal ba'i sras kyis shin tu bsten ma// phyag 'tshal tuttā ra hūṃ yi ge /'dod dang phyogs dang nam mkha' gang ma// 'jig rten bdun po zhabs kyis mnan te// lus pa med par 'gugs par nus ma/ phyag 'tshal brgya byin me lha tshangs pa// rlung lha sna tshogs dbang phyug mchod ma// 'byung po ro langs dri za rnams dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs kyis mdun nas bstod ma// phyag 'tshal traṭa ces bya dang phaṭa kyis// pha rol 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'joms ma// g.yas bskums g.yon brkyang zhabs kyis mnan te// me 'bar 'khrugs ma shin tu 'bar ma// phyag 'tshal tu re 'jigs pa chen mo// bdud kyi dpa' po rnam par 'joms ma// chu skyes zhal ni khro gnyer ldan mdzad// dgra bo thams cad ma lus gsod ma/ phyag 'chal dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgya'i// sor mos thugs kar rnam par brgyan ma// ma lus phyogs kyi 'khor los brgyan pa'i// rang gi 'od kyi tshogs rnams 'khrugs ma/ phyag 'tshal rab tu dga' bar brjid pa'i// dbu rgyan 'od kyi phreng bas spel ma// bzhad pa rab bzhad tuttā re yis// bdud dang 'jig rten dbang du mdzad ma/ phyag 'tshal sa gzhi skyong ba'i tshogs rnams// thams cad 'gugs par nus ma nyid ma// khro gnyer g.yo ba'i yi ge hūṃ gis// phongs pa thams cad rnam par sgrol ma// phyag 'tshal zla ba'i dum bus dbu brgyan// brgyan pa thams cad shin tu 'bar ma// ral pa'i khrod nas 'od dpag med las// rtag par shin tu 'od rab mdzad ma/

phyag 'tshal bskal pa tha ma'i me ltar// 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i dbus na gnas ma// g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum kun nas bskor dga'i// dgra yi dpung ni rnam par 'joms ma/ phyag 'tshal sa gzhi'i ngos la phyag gi /mthil gyis bsnun cing zhabs kyis brdung ma// khro gnyer spyan mdzad yi ge hūṃ gis// rim pa bdun pa rnams ni 'gems ma/ phyag 'tshal bde ma dge ma zhi ma// mya ngan 'das zhi spyod yul nyid ma// swā hā oṃ dang yang dag ldan pas// sdig pa chen po 'joms pa nyid ma/ phyag 'tshal kun nas skor rab dga' ba'i// dgra yi lus ni rab tu 'gems ma// yi ge bcu pa'i ngag ni bkod pa'i// rig pa hūṃ las sgrol ma nyid ma/ phyag 'tshal tu re zhabs ni brdabs pas// hūṃ gi rnam pa'i sa bon nyid ma// ri rab man dha ra dang 'bigs byed// 'jig rten gsum rnams g.yo ba nyid ma// phyag 'tshal lha yi mtsho yi rnam pa'i// ri dwags rtags can phyag na bsnams ma// tā ra gnyis brjod phaṭa kyi yi ges// dug rnam ma lus par ni sel ma/ phyag 'tshal lha yi tshogs rnams rgyal po// lha dang mi 'am ci yis bsten ma// kun nas go cha dga' ba'i brjid kyis// rtsod dang rmi lam ngan pa sel ma/ phyag 'tshal nyi ma zla ba rgyas pa'i// spyan gnyis po la 'od rab gsal ma// hā ra gnyis brjod tutta ra yis// shin tu drag po'i rims nad sel ma// phyag 'tshal de nyid gsum rnams bkod pa'i// zhi ba'i mthu dang yang dag ldan ma// gdon dang ro langs gnod spyin tshogs rnams// 'joms pa tu re rab mchog nyid ma// rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bstod pa 'di dang*/ phyag 'tshal ba ni nyi shu rtsa gcig /lha mo la gus yang dag ldan pas/ blo ldan gang gis rab dang brjod pas// srod dang tho rangs langs par byas nas// dran pas mi 'jigs thams cad rab ster// sdig pa thams cad rab tu zhi ba// ngan 'gro thams cad 'joms pa nyid 'thob// rgyal ba bye ba phrag bdun rnams kyis// myur du dbang ni bskur bar 'gyur la// 'di las che ba nyid ni thob cing*// sangs rgyas go 'phang mthar thug der 'gro// de yi dug ni drag po chen po// brtan gnas pa'am gzhan yang 'gro ba// zos pa dang ni 'thungs pa nyid kyang*// dran pas rab tu sel ba nyid 'thob// gdon dang rims dang dug gis gzir ba'i// sdug bsngal tshogs ni rnam par spangs te// sems can gzhan pa rnams la yang ngo*// gnyis gsum bdun du mngon par brjod na// bu 'dod pas ni bu thob 'gyur zhing*/

nor 'dod pas ni nor rnams nyid thob// 'dod pa thams cad thob par gyur te// gegs rnams med cing so sor 'joms gyur// rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyis bstod pa mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /
